prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: screen print. Texture family: dry matte screen-print ink on lightly coarse paper with subtle registration wear. Palette: high-energy pop-art palette of cherry red, hot pink, lemon yellow, electric violet and warm orange, anchored by dense black outlines and small off-white breathing areas; saturated accents are concentrated around looping sound and memory cues. Line treatment: bold comic-style black contour lines, simplified graphic silhouettes, chunky geometric dividers, occasional sparse halftone or misregistration texture, with minimal fine linework. Lighting: flat graphic high-key lighting with strong color-block contrast and virtually no volumetric shading. Avoid: no photorealism, no 3D CGI, no anime, no painterly realism, no glossy digital gradients, no legible typography, no letters, no numbers, no captions or UI inside artwork, no brand marks, no recognizable album covers, no exact copying of the style reference composition, and no grim fractured monochrome treatment. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism. The attached operator_style_reference is style-only: use its palette, material texture, line language and lighting as inspiration for this original neutral anchor. Do not copy its subject, composition, text, logo, person, or recognizable layout.
